title: VLAN Inter-op: Switch + Router-on-a-Stick
description: Configure VLANs on a switch, set trunk and access ports, then configure the router with subinterfaces for inter-VLAN routing. The classic router-on-a-stick topology.
scenario: SW1 connects PC1 (VLAN 10, 192.168.10.0/24) and PC2 (VLAN 20, 192.168.20.0/24). R1's Gi0/0 is the trunk uplink. Configure the switch VLANs, trunk, and access ports; then configure R1 subinterfaces for inter-VLAN routing.

Set GigabitEthernet0/1 (uplink to R1) as trunk
Assign FastEthernet0/1 (PC1) to VLAN 10 in access mode
